issues.title: Loan Simple leads triggering double tasks in post-referral workflow
issues.desc: Loan Simple leads were generating duplicate tasks across post-referral and other workflows, causing HAs and TCs to receive the same task twice. The root cause was a bugged filter related to LS lead associations in HubSpot. Madelaine Davis worked with HubSpot support to resolve the issue.
issues.workaround: Review any LS leads that received duplicate tasks during the impact window and manually close or dismiss the duplicate tasks.

issues.title: Post-referral workflow tasks not stopping when deal marked Closed Lost or Transferred
issues.desc: HAs were receiving post-referral workflow check-in tasks for deals that had already been marked as Closed Lost or Transferred. The workflow was not suppressing task creation upon deal stage change to terminal statuses. Madelaine Davis made a tweak to the workflow filters to address this.
issues.workaround: Manually dismiss any check-in tasks received for deals already marked Closed Lost or Transferred during the impact window.

issues.title: Offer Accepted workflow not re-enrolling deals that previously fell through
issues.desc: When a deal was previously marked as Offer Accepted, fell through, and was then marked Offer Accepted again, the TC assignment workflow did not trigger tasks because re-enrollment was not enabled. This caused TC task assignment to be skipped on the second contract. The workflow was updated to allow re-enrollment.
issues.workaround: For deals that cycled through Offer Accepted more than once during the impact window, manually enroll them in the TC workflow to ensure tasks are assigned.

issues.title: Post-referral workflow tasks not triggering for March 18 referral due to data pull error
issues.desc: A referral accepted on March 18th did not trigger any post-referral workflow tasks for the HA. The root cause was an error in how data was being pulled, which prevented the workflow from filtering correctly. The issue was escalated to product for resolution.
issues.workaround: Manually enroll any affected leads from the impact window into the post-referral workflow to ensure tasks are created.

issues.title: MRC and other TC Sale Pending and Offer Accepted workflows not enrolling correctly
issues.desc: TC workflows for Sale Pending and Offer Accepted deal stages were not enrolling MRC and other leads correctly, resulting in TCs not receiving tasks. The impact window was confirmed as February 26th through April 1st. The issue was resolved and confirmed fixed.
issues.workaround: Manually enroll any MRC or affected leads that were updated to Sale Pending or Offer Accepted between February 26 and April 1 into the appropriate TC workflow.

issues.title: Buyer credit SMS sent at Offer Accepted stage without credit amount populated
issues.desc: An SMS notifying the buyer of their credit amount was incorrectly being sent at the Offer Accepted stage before closing information had been submitted, meaning the credit amount was blank. The SMS should only send at the Sale Pending stage once the credit amount is calculated. It was confirmed to be a dash-triggered message and escalated to product.
issues.workaround: For any buyers who received a blank credit amount SMS during the impact window, manually send the correct buyer credit information once closing info is submitted.
